description:
**** Stunning Selection of One, Two and Three Bedroom Apartments & Duplex Units ****

Storyhouse are proud to introduce Two Oaks, a wonderful collection of duplexes and apartments in the heart of Knocklyon, Dublin 16. This development comprises a wide selection of 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments and duplexes, fully equipped and with Wi-Fi included and ready for you on move-in. Your standard of living at Two Oaks is enhanced by the inclusion of on-site amenities, which include an on-site property management team, co-working and lounge facilities, a gym and areas that can be rented for private parties or events. These stylish new homes come fully furnished and offer perfect convenience in a popular and well-established area, all within easy reach of Dublin City Centre. Simply turn the key and move in - and immediately enjoy the comfort and security that Two Oaks offers.

With plenty of excellent transport links, close proximity to the M50, and well-established local schools, supermarkets and facilities, Two Oaks is a great choice for all commuters and families alike. We also have car and e-bike sharing hubs in Two Oaks to make your life a little more convenient. And with the Dublin Mountains on your doorstep, you'll have plenty of opportunity to enjoy the Great Outdoors too.



**** EXTREMELY LIMITED PARKING SPACES AVAILABLE ****


**** For further information visit our website at www.twooaks.ie ****
